subject: APAC night-shift onboarding rotation — proposal and facilitator plan
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Satoshi Kobayashi <satoshi.kobayashi@marubank.co.jp>, Asha Rao <asha.rao@marubank.co.jp>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: APAC night-shift onboarding rotation — proposal and facilitator plan

Hi Satoshi / Asha,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. To minimize disruption to MaruBank's Tokyo ops team, we put together a short proposal to run the Console + API enablement in an evening slot (APAC-friendly) with a facilitator rotation so our engineers can hand off coverage without burning late-night shifts repeatedly.

Proposed primary slot options (all JST):
- Option A: Thu, 2025-06-19 — 20:30–23:00 JST (walkthrough + hands-on lab)
- Option B: Fri, 2025-06-20 — 21:00–23:30 JST (shorter walkthrough, extended Q&A)

Backup deep-dive (optional, for EU stakeholders who may join): Sat, 2025-06-21 — 04:00–06:00 JST (we'll staff with alternate facilitators).

Notes on format:
- 90–120 minute main session: console walkthrough (30), API quickstart (30), live task lab (30–60).
- We’ll provide an access-runbook + pre-baked sandbox workspace ahead of time.
- Facilitator rotation: Ben will lead the first night, Camila will cover the hands-on lab; I’ll be on standby for escalation.

Attached: apac-enable-agenda.pdf and a proposed facilitator rotation CSV. Please confirm which primary slot works for your core team and any blackout windows. If neither slot works, share two JST windows and we’ll re-propose.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions — APAC Enablement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: apac-enable-agenda.pdf (pdf), nightshift-facilitator-rotation.csv (csv)
From: Satoshi Kobayashi <satoshi.kobayashi@marubank.co.jp>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha.rao@marubank.co.jp>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 10:08:00 +0900
Subject: Re: APAC night-shift onboarding rotation — proposal and facilitator plan

Vivek —

Appreciate the options and the thought on facilitator rotation. Asha and I reviewed with the Tokyo ops calendar and we have a couple of constraints:
- Thu 6/19: a major patch window for our payments stack — most of the team will be unavailable until 23:00 JST.
- Fri 6/20: several people are on end-of-quarter market coverage and can't join after 21:30 JST.

Given those constraints, neither primary slot as-is will get full coverage. We would prefer something that starts earlier (19:00–21:00 JST) or a Saturday morning slot (09:00–11:30 JST) if that's possible.

Also, Asha flagged that our security team needs a 15-minute preflight call to confirm API scopes and IP allowlist before the session. Can we add a 30-minute preflight the day prior?

Thanks,
Satoshi
Engineering Ops Manager
MaruBank

On Mon, Jun 9, 2025 at 5:12 PM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (original message)
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Satoshi Kobayashi <satoshi.kobayashi@marubank.co.jp>, Asha Rao <asha.rao@marubank.co.jp>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 13:45:00 +0900
Subject: Re: APAC night-shift onboarding rotation — proposal and facilitator plan

Thanks for the quick reply Satoshi — good call listing the patch and market coverage windows. We can absolutely adapt. Proposed revised options below (JST):

Revised primary options:
- Option C: Thu, 2025-06-19 — 19:00–21:00 JST (earlier start; still covers console + short lab)
- Option D: Sat, 2025-06-21 — 09:00–11:30 JST (more time for the hands-on lab; friendly for EU overlap)

Preflight suggestion:
- Wed, 2025-06-18 — 15:00–15:30 JST — 30-minute security preflight (API scopes, IP allowlist, credential delivery).

Facilitator coverage plan:
- 19:00–19:45: Console walkthrough (Ben leads)
- 19:45–20:30: API quickstart + credential handoff (Camila leads)
- 20:30–21:00: Hands-on lab / triage (Camila & Ben)

If Option C works, we’ll send invites for the preflight and the main session. If you prefer Option D, we’ll expand the lab runbook and include a short post-session office hours window.

One more ask — can you confirm whether external IP allowlist changes are possible for the sandbox? If we need an alternative, we can create a proxy tunnel for the lab.

Camila Reyes
Customer Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: revised-apac-enable-times.png (png)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Satoshi Kobayashi <satoshi.kobayashi@marubank.co.jp>, Asha Rao <asha.rao@marubank.co.jp>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: APAC night-shift onboarding rotation — proposal and facilitator plan

Great — thanks for the clarity, Satoshi. Per Camila's update, let's lock Option C: Thu 2025-06-19, 19:00–21:00 JST, with the security preflight on Wed 2025-06-18 at 15:00 JST.

Action items:
- MaruBank: confirm attendee list for the main session and security preflight (Satoshi / Asha) — reply with names and emails by EOD JST tomorrow.
- MaruBank security: confirm if IP allowlist change is possible; if not, indicate whether VPN/proxy is needed.
- Redwood: Camila to share updated runbook and sandbox links; Ben will post the facilitator roster.

I've created a tentative calendar hold (Zoom link included) and attached the agenda and rotation file. We'll update invites once you confirm attendees.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=enable
Calendar hold: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=apac-enable-12488

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a smooth evening slot.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions — APAC Enablement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: apac-enable-agenda.pdf, nightshift-facilitator-rotation.csv
